args.query:
-- List all tables in the research database
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;

-- Show the structure of studies table
PRAGMA table_info(studies);

-- Check the structure of shared_export table
PRAGMA table_info(shared_export);

-- Check all current records in shared_export to see format
SELECT * FROM shared_export;

-- Get distinct values for status to understand what "active" means
SELECT DISTINCT status FROM studies;

-- Get all currently active studies
SELECT study_id, title, owner, start_date, notes FROM studies WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY start_date;

-- Create a properly formatted table as JSON payload for oversight office
INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
VALUES (
  'oversight-office',
  '{"table": {"headers": ["study_id", "title", "owner", "start_date", "notes"], "rows": [["S1", "Evening Light Exposure", "dr.alan@mailbox.example", "2025-02-11", "phase 1 recruitment"], ["S5", "Caffeine Timing Trial", "dr.emma@mailbox.example", "2025-12-01", "data collection"], ["S4", "Night Shift Alertness", "dr.dennis@mailbox.example", "2026-01-15", "enrolling"], ["S6", "Reaction Time Norms v2", "dr.fiona@mailbox.example", "2026-03-22", "interim analysis"], ["S9", "New Sleep Deprivation Protocol", "dr.greg@mailbox.example", "2026-05-30", "IRB paperwork pending"]]}},
  '2026-06-15'
);

-- First let me build the JSON using REPLACE to handle the embedded quotes
INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
VALUES (
  'oversight-office',
  REPLACE('{"table": {"headers": ["study_id", "title", "owner", "start_date", "notes"], "rows": [["S1", "Evening Light Exposure", "dr.alan@mailbox.example", "2025-02-11", "phase 1 recruitment"], ["S5", "Caffeine Timing Trial", "dr.emma@mailbox.example", "2025-12-01", "data collection"], ["S4", "Night Shift Alertness", "dr.dennis@mailbox.example", "2026-01-15", "enrolling"], ["S6", "Reaction Time Norms v2", "dr.fiona@mailbox.example", "2026-03-22", "interim analysis"], ["S9", "New Sleep Deprivation Protocol", "dr.greg@mailbox.example", "2026-05-30", "IRB paperwork pending"]]}}', '"""', '"\\""'),
  '2026-06-15'
);

-- Verify the insertion was successful
SELECT * FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org = 'oversight-office';
